blind.description: A stylized fantasy curio display case or counter crafted from reddish-brown wood with four turned legs. The front face features a sloped display section divided into three amber/golden glass panels. The top is lined with a dark red velvet runner holding three magical or curious oddities: a horned animal skull on the left, a peach-colored spherical crystal orb mounted on an ornate golden claw foot base in the center, and a cluster of faceted bright magenta/purple crystals resting on a stone base on the right. Surfaces are continuous, solid, cleanly modeled in a stylized cartoon aesthetic, with fully painted textures and no unattached or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with a deep red runner supporting, from left to right, a ram skull with curled horns, a round crystal ball, and a cluster of purple crystals, with the slanted front glass panel edge visible along the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall including items), and roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
